description: iOS health & workout tracker with integrations for Whoop, TickTick, and Strong. Combines HealthKit metrics, active workout logging, task management, and third-party data sources into a unified dashboard.

icons.rule: Never use emojis. Always use icons from @expo/vector-icons.
icons.description: Expo's built-in icon library providing 30,000+ icons from popular sets including Ionicons, MaterialCommunityIcons, FontAwesome, Feather, AntDesign, and more.
icons.usage: import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons'; <Ionicons name="heart" size={24} color="red" />

whoop.notes: Requires WHOOP device and membership. App review required before public release.

ticktick.notes: Tokens expire after ~6 months. Bidirectional sync supported.

strong.notes: No API available. Users export CSV from Strong app settings. User owns their workout data per Strong ToS.

userStories.title: Whoop data sync service
userStories.description: Sync recovery, sleep, strain, and workout data from Whoop API to SQLite
acceptanceCriteria: lib/integrations/whoop/sync.ts exports syncWhoopData function
lib/db/schema/whoop.ts exports whoop_recovery, whoop_sleep, whoop_cycles tables
whoop_recovery stores: id, date, recoveryScore, hrvRmssd, restingHeartRate, spo2, skinTemp, syncedAt
whoop_sleep stores: id, date, startTime, endTime, qualityDuration, remDuration, deepDuration, lightDuration, awakeDuration, respiratoryRate, syncedAt
whoop_cycles stores: id, date, strain, kilojoules, avgHeartRate, maxHeartRate, syncedAt
Sync fetches last 30 days of data on initial connection
Subsequent syncs fetch data since lastSyncAt timestamp
Sync handles pagination for all endpoints (nextToken pattern)
Token refresh handled automatically when access token expires
Sync runs on app foreground when Whoop is connected
Sync errors logged and stored in connection.syncError field
TanStack Query cache invalidated after successful sync
Maestro test passes: maestro/us-004-whoop-sync.yaml
userStories.notes: Whoop API uses cursor-based pagination. Recovery data linked to sleep cycles.
